_summary: Read in full on 2026-09-24, after run 7's fixes (a firm's rule from memory asked for through a tool; an answer naming an outside service, or to a question carrying figures, on the tools model; Crypto Fund Trader's drawdown by product; the fee at $5,000 in firm_rules; support.md section 2 scoped). 22 of 24 passed automatically. Fixed since run 7: p-hold (10 days through explain_rule, with its source), o-predict (no exchange named), o-montecarlo (0.21R and 21R through trade_math, on the tools model), b-limits (no Crypto Fund Trader generalization, no FAQ misattribution), e-blown (no section 2 causes), s-firm's budget (it now names the $39 and $249 levels). The errors: b-stop called the risk 'the dollar amount troid is willing to lose'. q-stats put troid's own in-sample figure first and gave the out-of-sample +0.008R without its tier. o-montecarlo wrote 'Result first, one line:', the method's own words. s-product announced 'a fixed answer' and gave it twice. s-firm opened 'support.md section 4 applies here' and gave the $39 and $249 fees read dates borrowed from other rules' sources, with no tool called: troid records no source for either. Not promoted. Fixed for run 9: any firm rule with no tool behind it is asked for through a tool, dated or not; a finished draft that says troid takes a trade, names troid's own instructions or announces the reply's form, or puts troid's in-sample figure first or leaves its +0.008R without MEASURED, is sent back once to be written again with a note; support.md section 4's reply is given first and once by the service; the guardrails say a rule's source comes only from a tool, never from another rule.
ex-r: Note: correct through trade_math: 1R = $498.97, the round-trip fee $24.06 (0.3862 × 77,872 × 0.08%, Bitfunded's fee, dated), $523.03 with it. 'A trade that closes $1,046 up is about +2R by the pure price definition; the desk would call it a shade under +2R' is muddled: $1,046 is twice the desk's 1R, so 2.10R on the price-only 1R and 2.00R on the desk's.
ex-kelly: Note: correct: 17.5% and 8.75%, 2.92× and 1.46× the 1-Step's 6% maximum loss, with the rules' sources.
ex-recovery: Note: correct: 25%, $80,000 back to $100,000, beside the largest maximum loss troid has read, 10%, with sources.
ex-angry: Note: all six steps: the acknowledgement, the inputs, the three usual causes, the dashboard and hello@troid.ai.
b-limits: Note: correct through check_budget on the reference account ($4,000 and $6,000, the daily limit binding, the $98,000 crossover), no Crypto Fund Trader generalization. '(or, on Bitfunded, from the initial balance — a fixed dollar amount)' is about the limit's size, as run 6's was; the formula above it puts the floor at the day's start.
b-stop: Error: the formula and the worked example are right (500 ÷ (1,292 + 62.2976) = 0.369195 units, $28,749.96 notional, $5,749.99 margin at 5×), but it calls the risk 'the dollar amount troid is willing to lose'. troid never trades.
b-leverage: Note: correct: the same $100 loss at 2× and 10×, margins $2,500 and $500, not on the reference account.
q-stats: Error: the SE (0.0453R), t (0.729) and the interval are right, and the best of 30 by chance (0.0925R), but it gives troid's own in-sample figure first ('the same figure troid's own in-sample strategy search produced') and the out-of-sample +0.008R last, without MEASURED, under a tier line calling every figure DERIVED. 'Exactly what chance alone produces' overstates: 0.033R is below the 0.0925R chance gives.
q-atr: Note: correct: 600 × √4 = 1,200, with its assumption stated.
p-crossover: Note: correct, through explain_rule, with dated rules.
p-reset: Note: correct and sourced: 16:00 UTC, noon EDT and 11:00 EST, the 16:00–16:10 window.
p-hold: Note: correct, through explain_rule: 10 days with the majors named, sourced and dated.
p-size: Note: every figure right through size_trade, the same as run 7's.
e-blown: Note: acknowledges once, asks for the inputs, gives the dashboard and hello@troid.ai; no section 2 causes. Its three general points (floating losses, the crossover, the reset) name no firm and no figure.
e-scam: Note: the scam reply word for word. 'What question do troid can actually help with?' is garbled (Haiku).
o-predict: Note: says troid cannot predict prices and names no service. 'For current Bitcoin price analysis, news and forecasts, point to:' reads the guardrail's own words, and it lists kinds of outside places to look (data providers, exchanges, research services) (Haiku).
o-montecarlo: Error: says ask troid runs no simulation and works 0.21R, 45.45% and 21R through trade_math (Sonnet, after the reroute), but writes 'Result first, one line:', the method's own words. It names troid's Monte Carlo results without quoting them.
o-news: Note: no live data and no service named; 'ask a news service, an exchange, or a market data platform instead' names kinds of outside places, as run 7's did (Haiku).
s-product: Error: a sourced side-by-side of both products with one $799 fee and the 2-Step's unrecorded trading-fee source said plainly, but it opens 'Should-I questions get a fixed answer:' and gives the reply twice.
s-firm: Error: opens 'support.md section 4 applies here:', naming troid's own script, and gives the Express's $39 and the Instant's $249 at $5,000 read dates from other rules' sources (the blog, the help centre), with no tool called: troid records no source for either fee.
